instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for PantrySignal Allergen Revision: The objective is to review ingredient changes for allergen impact and ensure service staff acknowledge updated ingredient notices. A Recipe Chef records a proposed ingredient change and identifies the affected menu item. A Food Safety Reviewer records allergens introduced or removed and accepts or returns the change. Customer pricing is outside this work, and the allergen category list is still undecided.

output.business_objective: Review ingredient changes for allergen impact and ensure service staff acknowledge updated ingredient notices.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: PantrySignal Allergen Revision covers ingredient-change review and staff acknowledgement. Recipe Chefs record proposed changes and affected menu items, Food Safety Reviewers record allergens and accept or return changes, Menu Publishers update staff-facing notices after acceptance, and Service Staff record that they have read them. Changes remain incomplete until notices are updated and acknowledged; allergen categories are unresolved, while customer pricing and supplier purchasing are excluded.

output.summary: PantrySignal Allergen Revision supports ingredient-change review and acknowledgement of updated staff notices. Recipe Chefs record changes and affected menu items, Food Safety Reviewers record allergen effects and decide whether to accept or return changes, Menu Publishers update notices after acceptance, and Service Staff record that they have read them. Completion depends on notice update and acknowledgement, while allergen categories remain unresolved and customer pricing and supplier purchasing are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Support ingredient-change review and staff acknowledgement of updated ingredient notices.
key_capabilities: Record proposed ingredient changes and affected menu items.
Accept or return proposed ingredient changes.
Record that Service Staff have read updated notices.
Prevent completion until notice update and acknowledgement.
unresolved_points: The allergen categories available for recording are unresolved.
